newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JCI mulls options after merger talks end.
newsitem.headline: JCI mulls options after merger talks end.

text.p: South African mining house JCI Ltd said on Monday it was discussing other ways to unlock value for JCI and Lonrho Plc shareholders after merger talks between the two companies were called off.

"JCI Ltd announces that it has discontinued talks with Lonrho Plc about a possible merger. However, the company confirms that it has been approached to discuss other possible transactions which could unlock value for shareholders in both JCI Ltd and Lonrho," the company said.
It gave no further details in a brief statement.
British conglomerate Lonrho said earlier it had ended merger talks with JCI which the companies had said last month were at a preliminary stage.
A merger would have created a mining house with a market capitalisation of around $3 billion.
